	<!-- App Url Rewriting -->
	<script type="text/javascript">
		// debugger;
		redirectByHash()

		if (!window.location.origin) {
			window.location.origin = window.location.protocol + "//" + window.location.hostname +
				(window.location.port ? ':' + window.location.port : '');
		}

		redirectByRewriteRules();

		function redirectByHash() {
			if (window.location.search == null || window.location.search.indexOf('hash=') === -1) {
				return;
			}

			const searchParamsMap = getSearchParamsMap(false);
			const searchHash = searchParamsMap.get('hash');
			const hash = `#${searchHash.startsWith('%') ? decodeURIComponent(searchHash) : searchHash}`;
			searchParamsMap.delete('hash');

			let search = '';
			if (searchParamsMap.size > 0) {
				search = Array
					.from(searchParamsMap.entries())
					.map((entry) => `${entry[0]}${!entry[1] ? '' : `=${entry[1]}`}`)
					.join('&');
				search = `?${search}`;
			}

			console.log(`Redirect by hash:\n- from: ${window.location.search}\n- to: ${search}${hash}`);
			window.location.hash = hash;
			window.location.search = search;
		}

		function redirectByRewriteRules() {
			// Processing only urls like following: index.html?route={routePath}&....  see PORT-2849 for details.
			if (window.location.search == null || window.location.search.indexOf('route=') === -1) {
				return;
			}

			const searchParamsMap = getSearchParamsMap(true);

			const route = searchParamsMap.get('route').toLowerCase();
			const path = searchParamsMap.get('path');

			let redirectUrl = null;
			switch (true) {
				case (route === 'form' || route === 'formbytask') && !!path:
					redirectUrl = `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}#/form/${replaceParenthesis(trimSlashes(path))}?`;

					if (searchParamsMap.has('uniqueid')) {
						redirectUrl += `workflowId=${encodeURIComponentWithParenthesis(searchParamsMap.get('uniqueid'))}&`;
					}
					if (searchParamsMap.has('taskID')) {
						redirectUrl += `taskId=${encodeURIComponentWithParenthesis(searchParamsMap.get('taskID'))}&`;
					}
					if (searchParamsMap.has('taskDueDate')) {
						redirectUrl += `taskDueDateInTaskTz=${encodeURIComponentWithParenthesis(searchParamsMap.get('taskDueDate'))}&`;
					}
					break;
				case route === 'generic':
					redirectUrl = `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}#/generic?`;

					searchParamsMap.delete('route');
					searchParamsMap.forEach((value, name) => {
						redirectUrl += `${name}=${encodeURIComponentWithParenthesis(value)}&`;
					});
					break;

				//add your routing rule here
			}

			if (redirectUrl) {
				redirectUrl += new Date().getTime();
				console.log('Redirect by rewrite rule to:\n', redirectUrl);

				window.location = redirectUrl;
			}
		}

		function encodeURIComponentWithParenthesis(str) {
			return replaceParenthesis(encodeURIComponent(str || ''));
		}

		function replaceParenthesis(str) {
			return (str || '').replace(/[()]/g, (c) => '%' + c.charCodeAt(0).toString(16));
		}

		function getSearchParamsMap(decode) {
			const search = (window.location.search.startsWith('?')) ? window.location.search.substring(1) : window.location.search;
			const searchPairs = search.split('&');
			return searchPairs.reduce((map, value) => {
				const pair = value.split('=');
				map.set(pair[0], decode ? decodeURIComponent(pair[1].replace(/\+/g, " ")) : pair[1]);
				return map;
			}, new Map());
		}

		function trimSlashes(str) {
			if (str[0] === '/') {
				str = str.substring(1);
			}
			if (str[str.length - 1] === '/') {
				str = str.substring(0, str.length - 1);
			}
			return str;
		}

		window.dynamicConfig = {

			timeAmPm: 'true',
			embeddedMode: false // Will be replaced by the embedded-maker post build script int the created embedded.html
		};

	</script>
